dialogue.sit: I've got some treasure I want to sell.

dialogue.t: You want to sell treasure? That's quite a surprise.
I imagine that an adventurer as skilled as you must have some truly rare goods to sell.

dialogue.sit: You tell Marjorie about the Dragonbone Orb.

dialogue.t: Huh, isn't this what the bards called the "Fretnaught Fruit"?
To think that it really exists... So its real name is the Dragonbone Orb.
If its effects are as you say, I'd be willing to pay 80,000 Mora and some specialty dishes for it.
Hmm... How does 80,000 Mora and 5 Moon Pies sound to you?

dialogue.sit: Let me think about it a bit more.

dialogue.t: Hehe. I mean, it's such a unique treasure.
Why, it has abilities straight out of a fairy tale! I doubt those alchemists would be loath to part with their Mora.
How about it? Told you that my price was the best, hehe!
If you sell it to me, my price is 80,000 Mora and 5 Moon Pies. Sounds reasonable, yes?

dialogue.sit: Let me think about it one more time.

dialogue.t: I'll take it, then. Thanks for your patronage!
Ah yes. Such beads formed from condensation tend to evaporate slowly in the wind.
As such, it might be best to cover it with a diaphragm or place it within a sealed container to ensure its quality.
I'll give you this tip free of charge. Hopefully, it'll be of some use to you in your adventures.
If you encounter such treasures in the future, always remember that you'll have a loyal buyer in me!
